scope: speed only; owner review remains locked; no SP-078 verdicts; no SP-079 final ratings; no shoulder work

construct.initial_acceleration: start and early acceleration from first movement
construct.end_to_end_90ft: ability to cover approximately 90ft, including speed maintenance
construct.stealing_technique: lead, jump, pitcher reading and slide technique; not physical speed
construct.baserunning_aggression_decision: attempt selection and advancement behavior; not physical speed

route_use_policy.physical_estimation_routes: must be PowerPro-label-free and treat The Show only as contextual appraisal unless direct physical measurements are present
route_use_policy.game_appraisal_behavior_routes: may model The Show and PowerPro rating behavior, but outputs must remain explicitly separate from physical latent speed
route_use_policy.ensemble_rule: never collapse route disagreement into an unlabelled average; emit route-level outputs, influence receipts and conflict reasons

routes.name: COMMON_METRIC_NEIGHBORHOOD_BRIDGE
routes.idea: Match MLB and NPB player-seasons with similar league-normalized shared indicator profiles, then compare The Show and PowerPro appraisal distributions.
inputs: shared MLB/NPB physical and baserunning indicators

routes.name: DUAL_SHARED_INDICATOR_BEHAVIOR_MODELS
routes.idea: Fit The Show Speed from MLB common indicators and PowerPro speed from NPB common indicators separately, then compare percentile predictions rather than fitting a direct game-to-game label map.

routes.name: MULTI_TRAIT_LATENT_MEASUREMENT_MODEL
routes.idea: Model peak speed, acceleration/90ft, stealing technique and baserunning aggression as separate latent traits with source-specific observation equations.
risks: game labels treated as physical truth

routes.name: WITHIN_PLAYER_TEMPORAL_DELTA
routes.idea: Use changes within the same player across The Show editions, Statcast seasons and PowerPro works to estimate responsiveness and decline without relying on level comparability.
risks: carry-forward rows mistaken for exact snapshots

routes.name: LEAGUE_TRANSITION_FIXED_EFFECTS
routes.idea: Estimate systematic differences around NPB→MLB, MLB→NPB and returnee transitions using player fixed effects and direction-specific time gaps.

routes.name: RATING_INERTIA_AND_STALENESS_MODEL
routes.idea: Measure how quickly The Show and PowerPro update speed ratings after physical or performance changes, separating current evidence from inherited reputation.

routes.name: PAIRWISE_ORDINAL_EVIDENCE_GRAPH
routes.idea: Represent trustworthy faster/slower relations as a graph and infer a latent ranking without requiring one universal numeric scale.

routes.name: DISTRIBUTION_AND_TAIL_CALIBRATION
routes.idea: Compare The Show and PowerPro rating distributions conditional on direct/shared metrics to diagnose compression, nonlinear tails and edition/version drift.

routes.name: THE_SHOW_ROSTER_UPDATE_RESPONSE
routes.idea: Use explicit The Show speed-change events to learn which real-world changes trigger rating revisions and how large those revisions are.
mandatory_qa: no inferred changes from unchanged snapshots

routes.name: RETURNEE_SYNTHETIC_CONTROL
routes.idea: For NPB→MLB→NPB returnees, compare the player with matched non-transition peers to separate aging from league-transition and injury effects.

routes.name: AGE_CURVE_AND_TEMPORAL_DECAY
routes.idea: Estimate speed decline curves by baseline tier, position and available injury context, then use them to discount old The Show/direct measurements rather than deleting them.
outputs: wide uncertainty when injury data are missing

routes.name: SCOUTING_GRADE_AND_TIMED_TEST_BRIDGE
routes.idea: Normalize 20-80 scouting speed grades, 30m/50m/60-yard/H2F times and qualitative scouting claims into bounded ordinal evidence with protocol confidence.

routes.name: PINCH_RUNNER_AND_USAGE_ROLE_CONTEXT
routes.idea: Use repeated pinch-runner deployment and tactical substitution as evidence that a team views the player as a useful runner, while controlling roster and managerial context.

routes.name: VIDEO_FRAME_TIMING
routes.idea: Estimate H2F or base-to-base times from broadcast frames when geometry and frame rate are auditable.

routes.name: DEFENSIVE_RANGE_AND_CHASE_CONTEXT
routes.idea: Use range/chase evidence only when straight-line physical movement can be separated from reaction, positioning and route efficiency.
mandatory_qa: no use of aggregate range as direct speed

routes.name: CROSS_SOURCE_CONSENSUS_AND_DISAGREEMENT
routes.idea: Compare physical, The Show behavior, PowerPro behavior, temporal, ordinal and context routes and preserve disagreement as information.

routes.name: NEGATIVE_CONTROL_AND_PLACEBO_SUITE
routes.idea: Test whether models appear predictive because of identity, edition, team, batting quality or leakage rather than speed information.

routes.name: DECISION_USE_AND_ABLATION_RECEIPT
routes.idea: For every current-100 player and every route, record whether the evidence changed, supported, contradicted or did not affect the appraisal.

definition_of_done_extension: MB-01 through MB-09 and MB-16 through MB-18 are executed or closed with measured negative findings.
Every current-100 player has route-level bounded missingness and decision-use states.
The Show and PowerPro behavior paths are visible and cannot silently overwrite physical evidence.
Route ablation proves what changed each player-level recommendation.
All important results, failures and negative findings are committed before Codex final response.
